item.name: 🤖 AI Advisor Agent
item.description: Production AI Financial Advisor endpoints — sessions, SSE streaming chat, tool confirmation, and feedback.

request.description: Creates a new AI advisor conversation session. The test script auto-saves session_id to the aiSessionId variable.

query.description: Set to true to list archived sessions instead

request.description: Returns all advisor sessions for the authenticated user, grouped by recency. Set archived=true to list archived sessions.
Full-text search of conversation session titles. Returns matching sessions with optional snippet.
Rename, archive, or pin a session. Send only the fields you want to change. Set archived: true to archive or false to restore. Set pinned: true to pin to top of sidebar.
Permanently deletes a session and all its messages. This action cannot be undone.
Returns all messages (user + assistant turns) for a session, ordered by created_at ASC. Each assistant message may include tools_executed.

exec: console.log('Pending action saved — use endpoint 09 to confirm/cancel');

request.description:
Sends a message to the AI advisor and receives the complete response (non-streaming). The agent runs tools internally and returns the final reply. For real-time streaming token output, use endpoint 08 instead.

Test script auto-saves:
- aiMessageId: the assistant message ID
- aiActionId: if a destructive action (create/delete expense) requires confirmation

Example messages to try:
• 'How much did I spend this month?'
• 'Compare September vs August spending'
• 'Am I over my food budget?'
• 'Explain Section 80C tax saving options'
• 'What are my top 5 expenses this month?'

Confirms or cancels a destructive action (create_expense / delete_expense) that the AI proposed. The actionId comes from a pending_action SSE event or non-streaming response.

Set confirm: true to execute, false to cancel.
Actions expire after 5 minutes for security.

Submits thumbs_up or thumbs_down feedback for a specific assistant message. Used to rate response quality.

rating: 'thumbs_up' | 'thumbs_down'
comment: optional text feedback
Deletes all messages in the given session (clears chat history). The session itself is preserved.
Local Ollama helper used by frontend fallback code. This is not an Express backend route.
